EventFaq1.subtitle: FAQS
EventFaq1.description: Find answers to common questions about our wedding planning services, process, and what to expect.

items.question: What are my options?
items.answer: We offer complete wedding planning, partial planning, event coordination, destination wedding support, decor, catering, photography and entertainment services.

items.question: Can I switch to a different plan?
items.answer: Yes. Your planning package can be adjusted as your celebration evolves, subject to availability and the services already confirmed.

items.question: Do you offer non-disclosure signature?
items.answer: Yes. We can arrange a confidentiality agreement for private celebrations, high-profile guests and sensitive event details.

items.question: Do you issue refunds?
items.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the selected package, cancellation date and vendor commitments. All terms are clearly explained before confirmation.

items.question: How far in advance should we book your services?
items.answer: For the best venue and vendor availability, we recommend booking six to twelve months in advance, especially for destination or peak-season weddings.

items.question: Do you help with travel and accommodation for guests?
items.answer: Yes. Our destination wedding support can include travel guidance, accommodation coordination, transfers and guest hospitality.

items.question: Can you manage both small and large wedding events?
items.answer: Yes. We plan intimate ceremonies as well as large multi-day celebrations, tailoring the team and planning process to suit your guest count.

items.question: Do you provide customised wedding themes and décor?
items.answer: Yes. Our designers create personalised themes, floral concepts, colour palettes and decor details around your preferred style.

items.question: Will you coordinate with local vendors at the destination?
items.answer: Yes. We source, brief and coordinate trusted local vendors while maintaining one clear plan and timeline for the entire celebration.

items.question: How do we get started with Eternal Moments?
items.answer: Book an initial consultation and share your date, location, guest count and vision. Our team will then recommend the most suitable planning approach.

EventTestimonials1.subtitle: TESTIMONIALS
EventTestimonials1.description: Real stories, beautiful memories and heartfelt experiences from our valued clients.

testimonials.name: Kylie Rogers
testimonials.quote: Our wedding was an absolute dream and we owe it all to this amazing team. From the initial planning to the final execution, everything was handled with perfection. The decor, coordination and attention to detail were simply outstanding.
testimonials.secondaryQuote: The team understood our vision from the very first meeting and made the entire process stress-free and enjoyable. Their creativity, professionalism and warm approach made our special day even more memorable.

testimonials.name: Daniel Cole
testimonials.quote: Every detail of our celebration felt thoughtful and personal. The planning team kept us informed, understood what mattered to us and made the entire wedding day flow effortlessly.
testimonials.secondaryQuote: Our families could simply enjoy the occasion because everything behind the scenes was managed with confidence and care. It was exactly the celebration we had imagined.

testimonials.name: Emily Parker
testimonials.quote: The styling was elegant, the coordination was seamless and the entire experience felt calm from beginning to end. Our guests are still talking about how beautiful everything was.
testimonials.secondaryQuote: We felt listened to throughout the process, and every choice reflected our personalities. The team gave us memories we will treasure for a lifetime.

detail.quoteText: A beautiful celebration is not only about one day; it is a journey of love, thoughtful details and memories that last a lifetime.
detail.conclusionText: Thoughtful planning turns every celebration into a calm and meaningful experience. Focus on what matters most to you, trust the right creative team and enjoy each moment as your story comes to life.
